summary: Iteration 21, frontend only. Retest of mouse drag-to-pan in the parking satellite modal after the fix (tile Images are wrapped in a pointerEvents='none' View in ParkingSatMap.tsx). Flow: TRUCK2026 -> skip onboarding -> 'Take me to Pilot Travel Center Lodi CA' -> parking-satellite-thumb -> parking-sat-map. FIXED: at 390x844, a mouse drag of +100/+80 moved parking-sat-place-pin exactly +100/+80, a reverse drag moved it exactly -100/-80, and the window dragstart count stayed 0. After the drag a new tile row loaded (9 tiles). At the 1920x1080 desktop viewport (z18, map 1920x892), the same +100/+80 mouse drag gave a +100/+80 pan with 0 dragstart. Regression, all passing: touch pan via CDP gave exactly -100/-80; pinch went 17->18->17; parking-sat-zoom-in went 17->18 and two zoom-outs went to 16; the footer 'Tap to close' closed the modal; parking-satellite-close (X) closed it at both viewports; the place pin and the E and P markers (2 parking-sat-spot-*) rendered, along with the route tail. No console errors or warnings.

issues: Carried over from iteration 20 (optional): pinch and +/- zoom around the view centre rather than the focal point, and desktop web has no wheel zoom.

action_items: None required. Optional: focal-point pinch zoom and mouse-wheel zoom on web.
critical_code_review_comments: ParkingSatMap.tsx: the pointerEvents='none' tile wrapper (line 143) correctly leaves the panHandlers View as the hit target, so there is no native img dragstart. The viewRef sync in useEffect and the PanResponder built with a useState initializer are both correct, and the grant handler reads the latest view through the ref.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (mouse pan fixed; all regression checks pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Same flow as iteration 20. To verify mouse pan, listen for window 'dragstart' (capture phase), drag with page.mouse in about 20 steps, and compare the bounding box of parking-sat-place-pin before and after. For touch and pinch, use CDP Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled plus Input.dispatchTouchEvent. Read the zoom level from the img src '/tile/{z}/'.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 20 bug (native HTML5 image drag stealing mousemove) is resolved: the tiles are no longer hit-testable, so the browser never starts a dragstart session.
